Where Does Your Rent Money Actually Go?
youtube_short.description: Nobody sits you down and explains what actually happens to your rent money. Over 10 years, the average American renter pays $204,240 — and keeps exactly zero of it. Meanwhile that same stream of payments quietly built $95,900 in equity for your landlord. Their mortgage principal dropped. Their property appreciated. Your net housing worth stayed at zero. And 63% of renters tell themselves they'll buy someday — most never do. The math on renting vs owning is more uncomfortable than most people realize. Run it for your city. Follow for money truths that actually change things. #rentvsown #personalfinance #realestate #homebuying #wealthbuilding
